title: The Ramgharias and Ghanaiyas Hunt Dileram's Hidden Wealth

blocks.text: Once the allied misls settle around the estate, the Ramgharias and Ghanaiyas divide the plunder in equal parts and begin acting together against Dileram's surviving family. Their partnership gives the search both military discipline and a sense that every new discovery will immediately become a contested prize.

Dileram's eldest son is seized, pressured, and forced to reveal where wealth has been hidden and who still controls portions of it. Under torture and fear of death, he yields locations, names, and caches that the attackers would not have found so quickly on their own.
The page therefore turns the story from open looting to coerced extraction. Betrayal, confession, and the narrowing search for treasure now matter more than the original attack on Dileram's house.
